newsitem.title: CANADA: Fire out at Imperial Oil refinery.
newsitem.headline: Fire out at Imperial Oil refinery.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said a fire that broke out at its Nanticoke, Ontario refinery on Thursday was out and the plant was still operating, although without a major component.
"The fire is over. The all-clear was called around (1600 Eastern time)," Imperial spokeswoman Janet Maaten said. "The refinery, for the most part, is operating."
Maaten said the fire, which was reported at about 1400 EDT, occurred in a pumping area of the 112,000 barrel per day plant's catalytic cracking unit.
A report released by Imperial last year showed Nanticoke's catalytic cracking capacity at 43,000 barrels a day.
The refinery, located about 100 km (62 miles) southwest of Toronto, is Imperial's third largest.
Maaten said the refinery was not undergoing any maintenance procedures at the time of the fire.
No injuries were reported, she said.
She added that the cause of the fire and its expected effect on production had yet to be determined.
"The incident's under investigation. I can't say much else," she said.
